author: Zintenka
body:
Hey everyone, Im gonna be making DarkTrot's sequel. I'm gonna be focusing on the gameplay and a little less aesthetics.

Gameplay>Aesthetics. 


So, as i was saying. It will feature only two main islands and one large island.

And... There... Will... Be... TNT..!

But you have to buy it from villagers... sorry but you have to earn the TNT. This will hopefully decrease the amount of potential greifers.

Planned Features:

  • 50vs50
  • Villagers
  • TNT 
  • Prime focus on gameplay.
  • Secondary focus on aesthetics.
  • Enchanting
  • Dispensers for increased TNT advancement
  • Comparators

Thank you for your time!

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
COWARD! You probably worry about your K/D. 

Yeah, TNT does that... lowers your K/D into the 0's... 

Anway, TNT is still fun. Despite its cons, alll you have to do is make sure your on the other side.

There are so many TNT tactics. 

Scatter Cannons... TNT running A.K.A. Suicide Bomber.... Barf Cannons A.K.A. Fountain Cannons... Chaos Cannons... Overkill Cannons... Counter Water Cannons...
Icarus Player Launchers... etc... *Loving sigh* And much much more...

All you have to do is adapt and learn then you'll love TNT like the rest of us!
